name: Atomic-frequency-comb preparation on Zeeman sub-levels of an Er:Ti:LiNbO3 waveguide at ~0.7 K and 3 kG (telecom quantum memory)
plain_name: Prepare a telecom-wavelength quantum memory in an erbium-doped crystal chip at 0.7 K inside a magnetic field
description: Askarani et al. (Calgary/Delft) cool a fibre-butt-coupled Er3+:Ti4+:LiNbO3 waveguide to about 0.7 K in an adiabatic demagnetization refrigerator, apply up to 5 kG along the c-axis, measure Zeeman-level lifetimes by spectral hole burning (350-800 G) and prepare 0.2-6.4 GHz atomic frequency combs at 1532 nm under 3 kG.
keywords: Prepare a telecom-wavelength quantum memory in an erbium-doped crystal chip at 0.7 K inside a magnetic field

sources.citation: Persistent atomic frequency comb based on Zeeman sub-levels of an erbium-doped crystal waveguide (Askarani et al., arXiv:1907.07780, 2019)

requirements.rationale: Long-lived Zeeman population storage requires spin-polarised Er ions at about 0.7 K.
All AFCs were prepared under a 3 kG (300 mT) field along the crystal c-axis.
Optional: the setup exposed the waveguide to fields up to 5 kG (500 mT).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
